name: desktop_mode
description: Control Jarvis desktop / floating / transparent panel mode. Use when the user says 'desktop mode', 'transparent mode', 'hover mode', 'floating panel', 'stay on top', 'move to top right corner', or 'go back to full app'.

parameters.description: Use 'enable' to enter floating/transparent mode. Use 'disable' to restore the full app. Use 'move' to reposition the logo to a different corner.
The screen corner for the floating Jarvis logo. Defaults to 'bottom-right' if not specified.
